label: common_0270_head_teacher_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Thank you for coming, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0270_head_teacher_02
text: Have you been enjoying your time here at\nNaranja Academy?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0270_head_teacher_02b
text: Have you been enjoying your time here at\nUva Academy?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0270_head_teacher_03
text: That is most wonderful to hear.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0270_head_teacher_04
text: I see... Do remember I am always here to lend an\near should you find yourself struggling in any way.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0270_head_teacher_05
text:
Now, you may be wondering why we could not
have simply conversed earlier in the cafeteria.\c
But let me assure you, there is a reason why I
asked you to meet me here in my office.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0270_head_teacher_06
text: It seems that a friend of mine has a rather serious\nmatter they would like to discuss with you.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0270_head_teacher_07
text: Ah, no, I’m afraid they aren’t actually here\nin this room with us. One moment, please.\r\nJust allow me to connect us...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0270_hakase_01a
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hello, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. It is nice to\nmeet you.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: common_0270_hakase_01b
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hello, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. It is nice to\nmeet you.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: common_0270_hakase_02a
text: My name is Professor Sada. I carry out Pokémon\nresearch within the Great Crater of Paldea—\r\nat a site known as [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Area Zero[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

label: common_0270_hakase_02b
text: My name is Professor Turo. I carry out Pokémon\nresearch within the Great Crater of Paldea—\r\nat a site known as [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Area Zero[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

label: common_0270_head_teacher_08
text: The professor is, in fact, a graduate of our fine\nacademy, as well as a splendid researcher.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0270_hakase_03a
text: Well. Allow me to get straight to the point.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

label: common_0270_hakase_03b
text: Well. Allow me to get straight to the point.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

label: common_0270_hakase_04a
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)], student ID number
805C393...\c
You are the student who travels with the unusual
Pokémon [VAR 0x0101(0001)], is that correct?[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

label: common_0270_hakase_04b
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)], student ID number
805C393...\c
You are the student who travels with the unusual
Pokémon [VAR 0x0101(0001)], is that correct?[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

label: common_0270_hakase_05a
text: Thank you. I appreciate that you were honest in\nconfirming the facts.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

label: common_0270_hakase_05b
text: Thank you. I appreciate that you were honest in\nconfirming the facts.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

label: common_0270_hakase_06a
text: Why would you attempt to lie? You appear in\nany number of clips from security camera footage\r\ntogether with [VAR 0x0101(0001)].[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

label: common_0270_hakase_06b
text: Why would you attempt to lie? You appear in\nany number of clips from security camera footage\r\ntogether with [VAR 0x0101(0001)].[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

label: common_0270_hakase_07a
text: Ah, not that I— I do not mean to offend you.\nIn fact, I wish to ask for your assistance.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

label: common_0270_hakase_07b
text: Ah, not that I— I do not mean to offend you.\nIn fact, I wish to ask for your assistance.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

label: common_0270_select_01
text: Assistance?

label: common_0270_select_02
text: With what?

label: common_0270_legend_01
text: Agia?

label: common_0270_hakase_08a
text: Oh. How good to see that you are well. It has\nbeen quite a while since we last met.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

label: common_0270_hakase_08b
text: Oh. How good to see that you are well. It has\nbeen quite a while since we last met.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

label: common_0270_legend_02
text: Gias!

label: common_0270_hakase_09a
text: Koraidon was once in my care, you see.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

label: common_0270_hakase_09b
text: Miraidon was once in my care, you see.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

label: common_0270_hakase_19a
text: Its Poké Ball was also originally mine. I assume\nyou received it from a young man called Arven.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

label: common_0270_hakase_19b
text: Its Poké Ball was also originally mine. I assume\nyou received it from a young man called Arven.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

label: common_0270_hakase_10a
text: I am no longer in any position to be able to\nmanage that Pokémon myself.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

label: common_0270_hakase_10b
text: I am no longer in any position to be able to\nmanage that Pokémon myself.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

label: common_0270_hakase_11a
text: This is what I would ask of you: Will you continue\nlooking after Koraidon on my behalf?[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

label: common_0270_hakase_11b
text: This is what I would ask of you: Will you continue\nlooking after Miraidon on my behalf?[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

label: common_0270_hakase_12a
text: I do appreciate your agreement.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

label: common_0270_hakase_12b
text: I do appreciate your agreement.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

label: common_0270_hakase_13a
text: And yet, it is clear to see from the way Koraidon\nreacts to you that you must be a kind Trainer.\r\nYour bond seems quite undeniable.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

label: common_0270_hakase_13b
text: And yet, it is clear to see from the way Miraidon\nreacts to you that you must be a kind Trainer.\r\nYour bond seems quite undeniable.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

label: common_0270_hakase_14a
text: Koraidon has been greatly weakened and is\ncurrently incapable of battle.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

label: common_0270_hakase_14b

mobility.\c
In all likelihood, it will require some time to
fully regain the capabilities it once had.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

label: common_0270_hakase_16b
text: I will provide you with my contact information.\nIf you would please get out your phone?[VAR 0x0114(000E)]

label: common_0270_hakase_17a

label: common_0270_hakase_17b

label: common_0270_hakase_18b

label: common_0270_legend_03
text: Agigia! Gias!

label: common_0270_head_teacher_09
text: Could this Pokémon have its origins within\nArea Zero...?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0270_head_teacher_10a
text: Sada... Don’t tell me you actually did it...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0270_head_teacher_10b
text: Turo... Don’t tell me you actually did it...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0270_head_teacher_10
text: Well, it seems that the professor is asking quite\nthe favor of you.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0270_head_teacher_11
text: But of course the academy is always here to\nsupport you in any way that we are able.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0270_head_teacher_12
text: I do hope you’ll continue to enjoy your school\nlife, together with that [VAR 0x0101(0001)].[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0270_head_teacher_13
text: Area Zero, hm... What are you doing down there,\nProfessor...?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
